## Goal

Describe the inventory or developer outcome.

## Scope

- Surface:
- Status: `future/investigate`
- Product-boundary change: yes / no

## Privacy and safety

- [ ] No raw process commands, process IDs, full paths, or file contents emitted
- [ ] No auth, Mint, registry-write, Runtime_C2-write, or telemetry path added
- [ ] Unapproved remote endpoints remain rejected
- [ ] Consent and the Global AI Preview allowlist remain unchanged, or the
      required privacy/product-boundary review is linked
- [ ] Positive, negative, deduplication, and privacy tests added where relevant
- [ ] No npm publication or production promotion included

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run smoke:package`
- [ ] User-facing copy and accessibility checked when relevant
- [ ] Real-device checks described below when relevant

## Evidence

Summarize test output, screenshots, or real-device evidence. Remove paths,
device identity, prompts, account data, and credentials before posting.
